author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: The composable exports an intentionally empty frame-load callback.
findings.consequence: The public callback implies iframe load affects state although correlated messages are the sole authenticated readiness boundary.
findings.evidence: The empty callback is returned, passed through the parent, bound to iframe load, and invoked by a test only to prove no state change.
findings.recommendation: Delete the callback and all no-op plumbing while retaining postMessage as the sole readiness boundary.
verification: Traced every callback reference and lifecycle transition.

findings.summary: The returned API exposes internal message handling and unused selection state.
findings.consequence: Tests couple to public members no production caller consumes.
findings.evidence: Production search finds no consumer of handleMessage or selectedDictionary, while tests read them as internal state.
findings.recommendation: Keep handleMessage private and verify selected dictionary through telemetry rather than an unused reactive ref.
verification: Searched all production/test consumers and inspected telemetry flow.

findings.summary: Route invalidation is owned by both the composable and its sole production caller.
findings.consequence: Every route change invokes the idempotent lifecycle close twice.
findings.evidence: Both the composable and ReaderDictionaryLookup watch route.fullPath and close the same lifecycle.
findings.recommendation: Retain centralized caller cleanup and composable unmount cleanup, removing the duplicate composable route watch.
verification: Compared both watchers and their route-invalidation coverage.
